title: connector fetch response, v0
description: 200 body of POST /v0/contributions/connector/fetch. The engine validates every item as it validates a client submission before accepting it, and advances the checkpoint only after the items are durably accepted.

checkpoint.description: The opaque checkpoint that resumes after this page (any JSON value, at most the declared limits.max_checkpoint_bytes serialized, 64 KiB by default). Return the request's checkpoint unchanged when nothing moved.

more.description: true asks for another page in the same run; the checkpoint must then have moved.

reads.description: Source resources this page read; feeds the per-UTC-day usage counters.

diagnostics.description: Kind-defined diagnostics exposed as Connector Health diagnostics (at most 16 KiB serialized); the latest page's value replaces the previous one.

notice.description: A condition to report on a run that completed normally, such as a spend cap; it ends the run.

not_due.description: true: the source asked not to be polled yet (for example an RSS ttl). The run is skipped: no items, more false and the request's checkpoint unchanged.

Item.description: One source item that is new or changed since the checkpoint: the same ingestion command a client submits, with producer = the Connector Instance. Exactly one of content and withdraw: true.

record_key.description: Stable source identity within the Source Namespace.

revision.description: Identifies the item content; absent derives it from the content. Set it when the item has attachments, so an unchanged item is recognised before anything is downloaded.

content.description: Text or a Manifest. A connector Manifest carries no Blob Parts: binary Parts are attachments.

extensions.description: Record Version extensions, only in namespaces the plugin declares.

withdraw.description: true asks for a Tombstone instead of a new version, for example a post deleted at the source.

Attachment.description: A binary Part of the item. The core asks for the bytes later through a core-issued upload grant (not part of Plugin API 0.3), only when the item is not already accepted.

size_bytes.description: Announced size, when the source provides it.

ref.description: Opaque handle the plugin understands, given back when the core asks for the bytes.
